posts.title: llmtee: A lightweight LLM proxy
posts.description: TL;DR: llmtee is a self-hosted proxy for the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, plus any OpenAI-compatible provider. Change one base URL, and every request gets logged with tokens, cost, latency and time to first token. It's a single Go binary with a SQLite file. I use LLMs in a lot of places by now.
